Name: Soffy's Characters for mono's Portraits
Author: Nekotekina
Description:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16649]Mono's portraits[/url] is by far my favorite portraits mod, so I created this to make the vanilla cast look as close as possible to those portraits, while keeping the original style. Of course, you're not required to use mono's portraits if you still like my mod's changes without it, but I highly recommend it!

[b]THIS IS A WORK IN PROGRESS. PLEASE BE PATIENT﻿.
08/05 - I'm not having much time to work on the rest of the characters for now. Will resume to work on them when I can.

[/b]Finished characters:

[b]Alex
- [/b]Changed hairstyle and hair color;
- Changed the main outfit to better fit the leatherman jacket in the portrait;
- Made him taller and bulkier;
- Changed hoodie and shirt in winter outfit;
- Changed winter outfit color;
- Changed muscles in beach outfit;
- Changed several sprites for better animations;
- Changed skin color.

The next character will probably be Abigail, as I'm already working on her.

This mod changes the male bachelors' Flower Dance sprites; if you want them all to match while I update the characters, you can download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24960]this mod[/url].

[b]Special note:[/b] 90% of users who download my mods forget to endorse them. If you like this mod, consider endorsing it! It shows appreciation for our efforts and greatly helps me by allowing more people to see it.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/WzQQc1T/ENDORSE.gif[/img]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/suHzq2E.png[/img]
1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher;
2. Download this mod & extract [CP] Soffy's Characters for mono's Portraits folder to Stardew Valley/Mods;
3. Run the game with SMAPI to play.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/M7KlO44.png[/img]
Should be compatible with most mods, unless they also change these characters' sprites.
